people.gen.rating_explanation: Overall is the era-weighted sum of the attributes (each 1–20), scaled to 1–100. Potential is the hidden ceiling and is never below overall. A person counts as a star at potential {starThreshold} or higher. Weights, age bands, and this threshold are estimates and can be edited without changing the generator.
people.gen.column.name: name
world.attribute.scale_explanation: Attributes are whole numbers from {min} to {max}. They are estimates until they are calibrated.
world.knowledge.band_explanation: A band ({low}–{high}) is what one organization believes about an attribute, not the true value. Both ends are whole numbers on the attribute scale, and the band can be wrong.
world.potential.explanation: Potential is the hidden ceiling of an attribute: a whole number from {min} to {max}, never below the current value. An organization sees a band, not this ceiling. The ceiling is an estimate.
world.salary.explanation: Salary is a whole number of nominal currency units on the contract. It is a placeholder estimate until the economy is calibrated.
world.budget.explanation: Budget is a whole-number placeholder estimate for an organization's nominal money. It is not a calibrated season budget.

career.run.estimates: These rules are estimates, not measured facts. A driver may retire from age {driverFrom} and always retires at {driverCertain}. Staff may retire from age {staffFrom} and always retire at {staffCertain}. The chance on a birthday rises in equal steps from the first of those ages and is certain at the second. A scheduled driver enters the talent pool on {entryDate} of the scheduled year. Each later season adds {intake} generated drivers to the pool. A contract ending is recorded and is not renegotiated.

career.run.hash_note: The state hash is the world on the morning of 1 January after that season. Alive, retired and pool counts are kept beside it; retirement and the talent pool are not fields of the world hash.
